skirmishes.place: Same time window: our Outer Tower (they took it)
Same time window: Fangtooth (we took it)

notes: The kills in this window fell on opposite sides of the map (offlane and duo lane): two separate plays, not one fight.
🎮 private (midlane) was dead — went down 36s earlier, so this was never a full-strength fight.
Enemy ran 1 healer (Muriel) and the team built zero anti-heal — their sustain ran unchecked.
Their main damage was Sparrow (16k physical); 0/5 of us itemized armor — that hurt.
Enemy ran 0/5 on or near their meta core — they were off-meta too, the win was there.

draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane), Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry).

coaching.headline: A 22-7 map win — every Fangtooth was ours and their objective damage was 457. The paper lane reads said otherwise; the map said this.
coaching.team: The lane sheet had our jungle, support and offlane behind on paper, and the map ignored it: majors 22-7 and a 37,410-to-457 objective-damage gap. The sloppy part a better team punishes: we built zero anti-heal into Muriel, so their sustain ran unchecked in every long fight, and we left the 11.9 won fight unbanked. Clean map play; the itemization discipline is the gap.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Owning every Fangtooth (15, 21, 26) plus Genesis at 25 — the fights were small (won 2-0 at 11.9, 2-1 at 24.7), and the 24.7 win cashed straight into Genesis.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase went 0/0/6 with 11 wards — the enabling was clean. The note is the build: all four items sat off the Marshal / Enra's Blessing / Galaxy Greaves meta core, and with nobody buying anti-heal into Muriel, the support slot was the natural place for it.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: The paper read said the jungle was Greystone's; Kallari's 5/1/0 with 22.6k objective damage said otherwise — that objective damage was the engine of the 37k-to-457 gap. The habit to fix is vision: 2 wards all game on a hero that lives in the enemy jungle.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Skylar won the lane early and finished 3/1/4 with 8.9k objective damage — tidy. Nobody on the team bought anti-heal into Muriel; on the carry, Tainted Rounds slots in without costing damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

gideon.loadout: Vesh (Lich + Phylactery), augment Event Horizon, crest Soulbearer
ultPlus: Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 27 minutes, fewer deaths than about 89% of Gideon mid players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Black Hole at top rank: 105s base, about 78.9s by the end (25% shorter) from 33 ability haste: Timewarp 25, Soulbearer 8.
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Gideon dealt 29,630 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +410 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Neon (level 15 estimated: about 44 magical armor, 24 after penetration) and Howitzer (level 15 estimated: about 44 magical armor, 24 after penetration) that is about 16% and 16% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 17.8% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Event Horizon (augment): Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

Sustain: Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 1,959 healing recorded.

Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Neon took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 (estimated) their armor was about 44, about 24 after 20 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 33 ability haste brought them back 25% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Soulbearer, Lich.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Phylactery) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Gideon killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Sparrow. We killed Gideon 1 time.
Copy it? Vesh (Lich + Phylactery): 49% in 343 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.8%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Black Hole came back about every 79s instead of 105s by the end (25% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
